svg.text: Design Token System Architecture — LLD
Token Hierarchy & Taxonomy
Primitive tokens: raw values — blue-500: #3b82f6, space-4: 16px
Semantic tokens: meaning-bearing — color-action-primary: {blue-500}
Component tokens: scoped to component — btn-primary-bg: {color-action-primary}
3-layer chain: primitive → semantic → component (never skip layers)
Token categories: color, typography, spacing, border, shadow, motion
Naming convention: {category}-{variant}-{state} e.g. color-text-disabled
Source of truth: single JSON/YAML file (Style Dictionary, Tokens Studio)
Platform outputs: CSS vars, iOS Swift, Android XML — one source, many targets
CSS Variable Injection & Runtime Theming
CSS custom properties: --color-action-primary: #3b82f6 on :root
Theme switching: override vars on [data-theme="dark"] selector
No JS required for theme switch — CSS vars cascade automatically
SSR: add data-theme to html element server-side to avoid FOUC
localStorage: persist theme choice; read before first paint (inline script)
System preference: prefers-color-scheme media query as default
CSS-in-JS: tokens as JS object passed via ThemeProvider context
Shadow DOM: CSS vars pierce shadow boundaries — shared tokens work
Multi-Brand & White-Label Architecture
Brand tokens: separate primitive set per brand, shared semantic layer
Token resolution at build: generate brand-specific CSS var files
Runtime brand switch: replace :root CSS vars on brand change event
Theme isolation: load brand stylesheet asynchronously; low CLS impact
Component agnostic: components reference semantic tokens only
Tenant customization: override component-level tokens per tenant config
Token API: REST endpoint returns brand tokens as JSON → CSS vars
Fallback chain: tenant tokens → brand tokens → default tokens
Tooling, Distribution & Governance
Style Dictionary: transforms JSON tokens → platform outputs in CI
Tokens Studio (Figma): designers edit tokens in Figma → sync to repo
NPM package: publish @org/tokens with typed JS + CSS files
Versioning: semantic versioning; breaking token changes = major bump
Visual regression: Chromatic/Percy screenshots on token change PR
Token linting: stylelint-no-unknown-custom-property detects undefined vars
Deprecation: mark old tokens with @deprecated; migration codemod
Governance: design team owns primitives/semantics; eng owns component tokens
3 layers: primitive → semantic → component
CSS vars on :root; data-theme override for dark
SSR: set data-theme server-side to prevent FOUC
Style Dictionary: one JSON → CSS/iOS/Android
Governance: designers own primitives, eng owns components
